listeningQuestions.audio: A clown doctor wears a bright wig and a big red nose to make sick children smile.
opts: 小丑医生戴鲜艳假发和大红鼻子,逗患病的孩子笑。
医生今天忘了带听诊器。

listeningQuestions.audio: Mark Twain was famous for his witty replies in everyday life.
opts: 马克·吐温因日常生活中机智的回答而出名。

listeningQuestions.audio: On April Fool's Day, people in many countries play tricks on one another.
opts: 愚人节那天大家都要上学。
愚人节是一个安静的节日。
愚人节那天许多国家的人互相搞恶作剧。

listeningQuestions.audio: Studies show that laughter helps the body make chemicals that lower stress.
opts: 研究说笑没有任何作用。
研究表明笑能帮身体产生降低压力的化学物质。

listeningQuestions.audio: Charlie Chaplin could make people laugh without saying a single word.
opts: 查理·卓别林不用说一个字就能逗人发笑。
卓别林写了很多严肃的小说。

listeningQuestions.audio: Lin Yutang told a short joke, which made the whole audience roar with laughter.
opts: 林语堂讲课从不用笑话。
林语堂讲了个短笑话,逗得全场哄堂大笑。
林语堂忘了自己要讲什么。

quizQuestions.q: A funny joke usually ____ when a child feels sad and will not smile.
The clown put on a curly rainbow ____ before walking into the ward.
Lin's audience ____ with laughter at his clever little joke.
On April Fool's Day, people love to play a ____ on each other.
Mark Twain, ____ was an American writer, was famous for his quick wit.
The little girl, ____ ankle was badly hurt, soon began to smile again.
He produced her sock from his pocket, ____ made the little girl laugh.
The clown doctors, many of ____ trained as actors, also learn medical skills.

opts: 小丑医生和真正的医生护士一起工作。
quizQuestions.audio: Clown doctors always work together with the real doctors and nurses.

opts: 看喜剧时别喝东西,否则会笑得洒出来。
quizQuestions.audio: Don't drink anything while you watch the comedy, or you'll spill it laughing.

reading.passage: People say that laughter is the best medicine, and science agrees. A good laugh helps the body make chemicals that ease worry, which is why clown doctors are so welcome in hospitals. A joke cannot heal a broken bone, but it can make a hard day feel a little easier.
reading.passageCn: 人们说笑是最好的良药,科学也同意。开怀大笑能帮身体产生缓解烦恼的化学物质,这正是小丑医生在医院如此受欢迎的原因。笑话治不好骨折,但它能让艰难的一天好过一点。

questions.q: Why are clown doctors welcome in hospitals?
opts: Laughter helps the body ease worry.

questions.q: What does the passage admit a joke cannot do?
opts: Heal a broken bone by itself.

writing.prompt: Write 3-4 sentences introducing a comedian or a funny person who makes you laugh. Say who they are, why they are funny, and how you feel. Try to use one non-defining clause, e.g. '…, who …' or '…, which …'.
writing.promptCn: 用3-4句话介绍一位让你发笑的喜剧演员或有趣的人:他/她是谁、为什么好笑、你的感受。试着用一个非限制性定语从句,如 '…, who …' 或 '…, which …'。

lines.text: Have you seen any good comedies lately?
lines.cn: 你最近看过什么好喜剧吗?

lines.text: Yes, I watched 'My Crazy Family', which made me laugh out loud.
lines.cn: 看了,我看了《我的疯狂家庭》,让我笑出了声。

lines.text: A comedian called Tom Lee, whose timing is just perfect. You should watch it tonight!
lines.cn: 一位叫 Tom Lee 的笑星,他的节奏感堪称完美。你今晚该看看!
